annotations.title: Recipes: nutrition, allergens and a shopping list

description: Returns source-linked food chemistry explanations for a small set of recognized ingredient combinations, when present, and a page with nutrition per serving and per day (USDA FoodData Central), allergen flags from ingredient names, any active FDA recall on a named brand, the recipe scaled to the requested servings, and one shopping list that merges the same ingredient across the week and rounds up to amounts shops sell, with price links. Inputs are one recipe or up to a week of days (each meal has servings cooked and servings one person eats). Amounts are a number plus a unit (g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, or a count); grams may be supplied for a can or a branded item. A brand is recorded only when one is supplied. Optional household details (adults, children's ages, allergies, foods to avoid) scale portions and flag conflicts; a weekly budget with a price estimate on each ingredient totals the list. Divux saves the result on a page at a Divux link, up to 25 plans a day per connection. Allergen and diet flags are based on ingredient names; the package label remains the reference. The numbers are nutrition data, not a statement that a meal is healthy or suits a medical condition. Not medical or diet advice. Applies to questions about the nutrition, allergens and shopping list for a recipe or a week of meals.

amount.description: Amount as a number, for example 1.5 or 1 1/2.

brand.description: Only when the person named a brand, e.g. 'Cheerios': Divux then checks recent FDA recalls for it

grams.description: Weight in grams of this whole amount. When present, it overrides unit conversion.

name.description: Ingredient name, e.g. 'rolled oats', 'chicken breast', 'olive oil'. Preparation goes in note.

per_100g.description: Nutrition per 100 g from the package. When present, the nutrition lookup is skipped.

price_estimate.description: Price estimate in USD for this amount of the ingredient. This tool does not look up prices.

query.description: What to look up for nutrition when name is not enough, e.g. 'chicken breast raw' or 'cheddar cheese'

unit.description: g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, or a count word (clove, slice, piece). Omitted for whole items such as eggs.

note.description: A short tip or description for the top of the page

servings.description: How many servings the recipe as written makes

steps.description: The method, one step per entry, in order

budget.description: Weekly food budget in USD. With price_estimate on ingredients, Divux totals the shopping list and warns when it's over.

days.description: A week of meals, up to 21 recipes in all. Omitted when one recipe is set.

make.description: Servings cooked; default the recipe's own servings

diet.description: Diets to check the ingredients against

goals.description: The person's own targets per day; the page's bars are drawn against them instead of FDA Daily Values

household.description: Family meals: who eats. Divux scales portions per person, and flags or rejects ingredients that break an allergy or avoid.

allergies.description: Allergies in the household: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame (or any other word, which is treated as an avoid)

avoid.description: Foods the household won't eat, e.g. 'mushrooms', 'cilantro'

kids.description: Each child's age in years, e.g. [3, 8]. Children get smaller portions by age.

strict.description: True to refuse the plan (nothing saved) when an ingredient breaks an allergy or avoid; otherwise they are flagged

recipe.description: One recipe. Omitted when days is set.

title.description: Name for a week plan, e.g. 'High-protein week'. A single recipe uses its own title.
